summary: States the IETF's position on building wiretapping capability into IETF standards-track protocols. It explains what the question means, why the answer is no, and what that answer implies. It is an informational statement of policy rather than a technical specification.

eli5.summary: A group that designs the rules of the road decided not to build secret listening tools into the road system. This note explains why they said no.
